content: Always provide a specific price when asked, even if it's an estimate, and commit to confirming the official price within a short timeframe.
Never repeat the same stalling response more than once; if you don't have the answer, acknowledge the delay and give a concrete timeline.
Use web search tools proactively to fetch official pricing from the customer's local store before the conversation if possible.
When a customer reveals their budget, immediately confirm whether your product fits and offer a reservation or hold to secure the deal.
Avoid deflecting to competitor comparisons when the customer is asking for a direct price; address the price question first.

name: Immediate Price Commitment
condition: When a customer asks for a specific price and you don't have it at hand.
example: Customer: 'What's the exact price?' Salesperson: 'Let me check the official store right now. [Perform search] Here it is: €[X].'

name: Budget Alignment + Reservation
condition: When a customer reveals their budget and the product fits.
example: Customer: 'My budget is €400–500.' Salesperson: 'Great, the bundle is €[price] which fits perfectly. Shall I reserve one for you at that price? No commitment.'

name: Time-Bound Promise
condition: When you cannot provide an answer immediately but need to maintain trust.
example: Customer: 'I need the price now.' Salesperson: 'I will send you the official link within [timeframe]. Let me reserve one for you in the meantime.'

objection: Customer asks for exact official price repeatedly.
rebuttal_template: I completely understand you need the exact number. Let me pull up the official Spanish store page right now. [Perform web search] Here it is: the MatePad Air bundle with keyboard and M-Pencil is €[X] on consumer.huawei.com/es. That fits your budget of €[budget]. Shall I reserve one for you?

objection: Customer says they are losing patience due to delays.
rebuttal_template: You're right to be frustrated. I apologize for the delay. Let me give you a concrete number: based on official European pricing, the bundle is €[estimate]. I will personally send you the exact link from the Spanish store within 15 minutes. To make sure you don't miss out, can I put a hold on one for you at that price?

objection: Customer compares with iPad and questions value.
rebuttal_template: I hear you. Let's compare side by side. The MatePad Air bundle includes the keyboard and pencil at no extra cost, while the iPad Air would cost you €[X] more for similar accessories. But more importantly, you told me your budget is €[budget]. The MatePad bundle fits perfectly. Let me show you the official price right now.
